{{Top|leg}}
'''Zisians''' were [[Near-Human]] [[species/Legends|species]] native to [[Zisia]] in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. 
==Anatomy==
Zisians had scaly green skin and orange eyes. In their old age, they often suffered from rheumy eyes and wrinkled skin hanging in loose flaps. One individual of the race was [[Ganar Tos]].<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
==History==
Zisians evolved on Zisia, a rich [[planet/Legends|planet]] which belonged inside the region of space dominated and controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], known as the Hutt Space. Zisians were docile and compliant and were [[slavery/Legends|enslaved]], [[millennia]] before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
==Behind the scenes==
While the physical description of Ganar Tos seems somewhat reptilian, his voice is described as "human,"<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> the term [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] is used in the text rather than Near-Human, and he apparently expected to be able to have children with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman, [[Bria Tharen]].<ref name="The Paradise Snare" /> For this to be possible, the Zisian species would have to be closely related to baseline Humans.
